items.title: Fixes & optimizations
items.body: Bug fixes, performance tweaks, and small stability improvements across the picker, board scan, and reward tracking.

items.title: Dune: Awakening 1.5
items.body: Donsraad now supports game version 1.5.

items.title: Auto stop at zero recollections
items.body: New Automation setting. When your mnemonic recollections are spent, the picker stops after claiming and AutoRun will not start another loop.

items.title: Mnemonic footer
items.body: Dashboard footer shows remaining recollections beside your target progress — green while tokens remain, yellow at zero, and a dash until the first HUD read.

items.title: House Swatches
items.body: Mark which cosmetic swatches you already own from the Rewards tab. Houses that hit 14,000 contribution are still marked automatically.

items.title: Contribution goals
items.body: Clearer goal picker. Manage swatch ownership in the new House Swatches window instead.

items.title: Locked missions
items.body: Houses without unlocked missions gray out and cannot be picked yet. The Landsraad tab shows clearer status when you need to scan first or wait for missions to open.

items.title: Mission picker
items.body: Green badge on the reward tier that matches your weekly goal.

items.title: Fixes & polish
items.body: Week rollover keeps your scanned board data. Less grid flicker when switching tabs, updated tab help, and other small fixes.

items.title: Major update
items.body: Landsraad house grid, weekly goals, reward tracking, and a simpler picker workflow.

items.title: Unified Start
items.body: Initialize is gone. Start runs first-time setup when needed, then goes straight into claim → refresh → accept.

items.title: Random guild names
items.body: New profiles and profile Reset assign a random five-letter guild name so you can refresh the board right away.

items.title: Reward Hunter
items.body: Mark reward items you are hunting. Icons show on Missions and Landsraad when those rewards appear on a scanned board.

items.title: House rewards
items.body: Rewards tab rows open earned tiers, week labels, and item names for each house.

items.title: User guide
items.body: How to use on the About tab opens an in-app guide for quick start, grid, Landsraad, rewards, and keybinds.

items.title: Landsraad tab
items.body: Scan the in-game house grid. See crests, contribution, progress bars, and weekly goals. Set goals and mark swatch ownership.

items.title: Missions grid
items.body: After a scan, the board shows revealed houses with icons and progress. Drag and drop to move or swap targets between cells.

items.title: Contribution tracking
items.body: Claiming a mission adds its Landsraad contribution to your tracked house. Hitting a goal shows a notification and plays a sound.

items.title: Goal estimates
items.body: After each claim, see how close you are to the weekly goal and how many similar missions are left.

items.title: Rewards tab
items.body: Track unclaimed house reward tiers per week. Claim or reset reward tracking per profile.

items.title: Tab help
items.body: Legend buttons on Missions and Landsraad explain colors, badges, and grid states.

items.title: Sound effects
items.body: Optional run-start and goal-reach cues in Settings.

items.title: Settings
items.body: Redesigned layout, configurable weekly reset day and hour, and a larger dashboard window.

items.title: Overlay
items.body: Stays bottom-left during picker work so it does not cover Landsraad UI. Goal notifications show house icons.

items.title: Run timer
items.body: Stop pauses the current-run timer. Start resumes without counting the paused time.

items.title: Smarter claiming
items.body: Avoids partial claims when not every target is complete. Shows a notice if no targeted missions remain after a claim.

items.title: Mission hunt
items.body: Skips house cells that already have your targets during filler passes, then accepts when every cell is ready.

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Tab overlap after Rewards, reward icons and week sorting, toast stacking for goal progress, and related UI bugs.

items.title: Per-profile settings
items.body: Guild name, faction, overlay, and delays are saved per profile. Hotkeys stay global.

items.title: Drag and drop
items.body: Swap or move missions between house cells. Cursor hints show when you can pick, move, or are at the three-mission cap.

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Cursor clear stays inside the game window in windowed mode. SESSION counter counts targeted leftovers during setup, then every claim after that.

items.title: Resolution support
items.body: Donsraad now supports 1080p, 1440p, and 3440×1440 in windowed or fullscreen windowed modes. Coordinates follow the game window, not the monitor.

items.title: AutoRun detection
items.body: Reliable View mission report detection across backgrounds. Finished runs are not misread, and the old 30-second wait is gone.

items.title: Session stats
items.body: The status bar shows how many missions you completed this session.

items.title: Keybinds
items.body: Separate hotkeys for Start, Stop, and Toggle AutoRun. Dashboard default is F8.

items.title: Overlay
items.body: Pins to the game window and hides when unfocused. Moves to the bottom left while picking so it stays out of the way.

items.title: Leftover mission report
items.body: For 10 seconds after targets are ready, leftover View mission report prompts are dismissed automatically.

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Completed-mission stats credit the correct mission when claims shift the active list. Guild name limited to 3–100 characters. Overlay settings layout no longer overlaps.

items.title: AutoRun mission complete
items.body: Auto mode can start the next loop from the in-world View mission report prompt. You no longer need the ornithopter Travel window. After you are ready, that prompt is ignored for 30 seconds so a leftover or mid-mission report does not fire again.

items.title: Availability
items.body: Stats estimates how often a mission shows up, using your last 30 pick cycles. It only tracks when you target exactly one mission from that specialization.

items.title: Ready notice
items.body: When the picker finishes, the overlay also tells you how many missions were abandoned that cycle.

items.title: Overlay
items.body: Top-middle placement is gone. It sat on the Landsraad tab. Existing top-middle settings move to top left.

items.title: Mnemonic devices
items.body: Remaining counts with two digits, such as 11/35, now read correctly.

items.title: Tray menu
items.body: If you hide the dashboard with X, the tray icon brings it back. Left-click shows the dashboard. Right-click can show the overlay, toggle AutoRun, start or stop the picker, and exit.

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Start no longer extra-clicks the house grid when every target is already active. Stats column headers line up with the values.

items.title: Overlay position
items.body: Move the on-screen HUD to any corner or the top middle. Bottom placements sit above the taskbar.

items.title: AutoRun
items.body: Leave the Travel confirmation open at the ornithopter and Donsraad starts the next picker loop for you. The overlay AUTO icon is green when this is on.

items.title: Mnemonic devices
items.body: The overlay shows remaining tokens after you initialize. Stats tracks how many you actually spent.

items.title: Travel window
items.body: Later Start runs close the Travel popup if it is blocking the menu.

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Renaming a profile no longer crashes if you switch tabs too quickly. Mnemonic remaining no longer shows 0 before the first real read.

items.title: Stats
items.body: Completes and best times per mission, plus session abandons and targeted accepts. Reset stats without wiping your settings.

items.title: Run timers
items.body: Timing starts once all targets are accepted. Claiming them saves last and best times.

items.title: Overlay
items.body: Optional notices when you are ready to run and when you set a new best time.

items.title: Dashboard
items.body: Wider mission grid, clearer hotkey labels, and profile names that no longer clip.

items.title: Action delay
items.body: Speed up or slow down the picker in Settings to match your client.

items.title: Auto claim
items.body: Completed missions are claimed on initialize and again when you press Start after a run.

items.title: Cancel
items.body: Press Start while a loop is running to stop it. The overlay shows the cancel hint.

items.title: Reliability
items.body: Clearer overlay hints, snappier waiting, and a more reliable guild refresh.
First release. Pick targets on the house grid, initialize, re-roll the board, and accept the missions you want.
